styles.name: Boxing
styles.stance: Orthodox: hands high near chin, elbows tucked, lead shoulder forward.
styles.philosophy_in_one_line: Hit and don't get hit using footwork and head movement.
styles.drawing_cues: Large circles for hands (gloves), slightly hunched torso.

techniques.name: Jab
techniques.real_description: A quick, straight lead-hand punch used to gauge distance and disrupt the opponent.

techniques.name: Cross
techniques.real_description: A powerful straight punch thrown from the rear hand with full hip rotation.

techniques.name: Lead Hook
techniques.real_description: A semi-circular punch thrown with the lead hand, elbow bent at 90 degrees.

techniques.name: Uppercut
techniques.real_description: An upward-traveling punch aimed at the chin or solar plexus.

styles.name: Muay Thai
styles.stance: Square stance, weight on back leg, lead foot tapping, hands high and open.
styles.philosophy_in_one_line: The Art of Eight Limbs: using fists, elbows, knees, and shins.
styles.drawing_cues: Mongkhon headband, armbands (pra jiad), upright posture.

techniques.name: Thai Roundhouse
techniques.real_description: A powerful kick using the shin as a baseball bat, rotating the entire body.

techniques.name: Teep
techniques.real_description: A lead leg push-kick used to control distance and knock opponents back.

techniques.name: Horizontal Elbow
techniques.real_description: A short-range slashing strike with the tip of the elbow.

techniques.name: Clinch Knee
techniques.real_description: A driving knee strike delivered while controlling the opponent's neck.

styles.name: Taekwondo
styles.stance: Side-on stance, light on feet, hands low for balance.
styles.philosophy_in_one_line: The way of the hand and foot, emphasizing high, fast, spinning kicks.
styles.drawing_cues: Dobok uniform, high-reaching leg lines.

techniques.name: Fast Kick
techniques.real_description: A rapid lead-leg roundhouse kick with a small hop forward.

techniques.name: Spinning Hook Kick
techniques.real_description: A 360-degree spin delivering a heel strike across the opponent's head.

techniques.name: Side Kick
techniques.real_description: A linear kick using the heel, chambered by pulling the knee to the chest.

techniques.name: Axe Kick
techniques.real_description: A high kick that drops the heel vertically onto the opponent.

styles.name: Capoeira
styles.stance: Ginga: a rhythmic, dancing movement shifting weight between front and back.
styles.philosophy_in_one_line: Fluidity, acrobatics, and deception through constant motion.
styles.drawing_cues: Low-crouched poses, one hand often touching the ground.

techniques.name: Meia Lua de Compasso
techniques.real_description: A spinning heel kick performed with both hands on the ground for balance.

techniques.name: Martelo
techniques.real_description: A 'hammer' roundhouse kick delivered from a low stance.

techniques.name: Armada
techniques.real_description: A standing spinning crescent kick.

styles.name: Kyokushin Karate
styles.stance: Sanchin or Fudo-dachi: rooted, heavy, hands mid-height.
styles.philosophy_in_one_line: The ultimate truth: conditioning and power to withstand and deliver heavy blows.
styles.drawing_cues: Bare knuckles, wide-legged stance, heavy torso.

techniques.name: Seiken Chudan Tsuki
techniques.real_description: A powerful mid-level straight punch focused on the solar plexus.

techniques.name: Brazilian Kick
techniques.real_description: A question-mark kick that starts low and arcs over the guard into the head.

techniques.name: Shita Tsuki
techniques.real_description: A short, inverted hook/uppercut to the liver.

styles.name: Wing Chun
styles.stance: Kim Yeung Ma: toes pointed inward, knees close, hands on centerline.
styles.philosophy_in_one_line: Simultaneous attack and defense using the shortest path.
styles.drawing_cues: Vertical fists, elbows close to the body center.

techniques.name: Chain Punch
techniques.real_description: A rapid succession of vertical punches along the centerline.

techniques.name: Pak Sau Strike
techniques.real_description: A slapping block that transitions instantly into a palm strike.

styles.name: Lethwei
styles.stance: Similar to Muay Thai but more aggressive, hands often lower.
styles.philosophy_in_one_line: The Art of Nine Limbs: including the headbutt.
styles.drawing_cues: Gauze-wrapped hands, aggressive forward lean.

techniques.name: Headbutt
techniques.real_description: A violent forward strike using the hard part of the cranium.

styles.name: Savate
styles.stance: High, mobile stance, hands held open and forward.
styles.philosophy_in_one_line: Elegant and precise kicking using the shoes as weapons.
styles.drawing_cues: Pointed toes (shoes), slim profile.

techniques.name: Chassé Lateral
techniques.real_description: A piston-like side kick using the heel of the shoe.

styles.name: Judo
styles.stance: Upright, looking for grips on the opponent's jacket.
styles.philosophy_in_one_line: Maximum efficiency, minimum effort: using the opponent's weight against them.
styles.drawing_cues: Wide sleeves, thick belt, grabbing hands.

techniques.name: Seoi Nage
techniques.real_description: A shoulder throw where the opponent is pulled over the back.

styles.name: Sumo
styles.stance: Low squat (shiko), hands touching the ground before the charge.
styles.philosophy_in_one_line: Push the opponent out of the ring or down to the floor instantly.
styles.drawing_cues: Large belly, thick legs, topknot hair.

techniques.name: Tsuppari
techniques.real_description: Rapid, powerful open-palm thrusts to the chest and chin.

styles.name: Jeet Kune Do
styles.stance: Lead hand and foot forward (strong side forward), constant rhythmic movement.
styles.philosophy_in_one_line: Be like water; have no way as way, no limitation as limitation.
styles.drawing_cues: Relaxed but ready, fingers often extended.

techniques.name: Lead Straight
techniques.real_description: The 'longest' punch, thrown from the lead hand with a small step.

styles.name: Systema
styles.stance: Completely relaxed, upright, natural walking posture.
styles.philosophy_in_one_line: Non-resistance and breathing to dissipate impact and return energy.
styles.drawing_cues: Loose limbs, very vertical torso, 'heavy' appearance.

techniques.name: Heavy Body Shot
techniques.real_description: A relaxed, whip-like punch that sinks deep into the opponent's organs.

styles.name: Krav Maga
styles.stance: Neutral or semi-passive stance, transitioning instantly to aggression.
styles.philosophy_in_one_line: Neutralize the threat as quickly as possible by any means necessary.
styles.drawing_cues: Tactical posture, hands open and near face.

techniques.name: Groin Kick
techniques.real_description: An upward snapping kick to the groin using the shin or instep.

styles.name: Sambo
styles.stance: Wrestling-based stance, slightly hunched, ready to shoot or strike.
styles.philosophy_in_one_line: Self-defense without weapons: combining striking with devastating grappling.
styles.drawing_cues: Kurtka jacket, short shorts, wrestling shoes.

techniques.name: Casting Punch
techniques.real_description: A long, looping overhand punch that looks like casting a fishing line.

styles.name: Silat
styles.stance: Low, wide, animal-like stances (Harimau), hands in intricate patterns.
styles.philosophy_in_one_line: Deceptive movement and ruthless finishing strikes to vital points.
styles.drawing_cues: Very low center of gravity, blades (keris) often implied.

techniques.name: Elbow Spike
techniques.real_description: A downward elbow strike aimed at the opponent's collarbone or spine.

styles.name: Bajiquan
styles.stance: Ma Bu (Horse Stance), explosive and rooted.
styles.philosophy_in_one_line: Explosive, short-range power using the whole body as a battering ram.
styles.drawing_cues: Sudden stomps, shoulder-first lunges.

techniques.name: Shoulder Ram
techniques.real_description: A powerful forward lunge striking with the shoulder.

styles.name: Kenjutsu
styles.stance: Chudan-no-kamae: sword held with both hands pointing at opponent's throat.
styles.philosophy_in_one_line: One cut, one life: precision and timing with the blade.
styles.drawing_cues: Holding a long thin object (katana), Hakama pants.

techniques.name: Overhead Slash
techniques.real_description: A vertical downward cut from above the head.

styles.name: Wrestling
styles.stance: Low crouch, arms out, ready to shoot for the legs.
styles.philosophy_in_one_line: Control the opponent's body and force them to the ground.
styles.drawing_cues: Singlet, bent knees, reaching arms.

techniques.name: Double Leg Takedown
techniques.real_description: Diving at the opponent's legs and driving forward to tackle them.

styles.name: BJJ
styles.stance: Low, hands out, often ready to pull guard or sit down.
styles.philosophy_in_one_line: Ground fighting and submission through leverage and technique.
styles.drawing_cues: Gi uniform, often shown in a seated or ground position.

techniques.name: Flying Armbar
techniques.real_description: Leaping onto the opponent to transition into an armlock.

styles.name: Street Fighting
styles.stance: Unrefined, aggressive, hands often balled into fists at chest height.
styles.philosophy_in_one_line: Win by any means, usually through overwhelming aggression and dirty tactics.
styles.drawing_cues: Wild swings, asymmetrical posture.

techniques.name: Haymaker
techniques.real_description: A wild, wide, swinging punch with maximum effort and no technique.

styles.name: Aikido
styles.stance: Hanmi: relaxed, triangular stance, hands open and circular.
styles.philosophy_in_one_line: Harmonizing with the opponent's energy to redirect and neutralize.
styles.drawing_cues: Flowing Hakama, circular hand motions.

techniques.name: Iriminage
techniques.real_description: Entering strike and throw that leads the opponent's head in a circle.

styles.name: Tai Chi
styles.stance: Slow, balanced, weight shifting between 'empty' and 'full' legs.
styles.philosophy_in_one_line: Softness overcomes hardness; internal power through slow, mindful movement.
styles.drawing_cues: Rounded arms, one leg often slightly bent.

techniques.name: Single Whip
techniques.real_description: A wide, spreading motion of the arms ending in a hook-hand strike.

styles.name: Shaolin Kung Fu
styles.stance: Low, dramatic stances like the Dragon or Tiger.
styles.philosophy_in_one_line: Channeling the spirit and movements of animals for combat and enlightenment.
styles.drawing_cues: Claw-like hands, deep lunges, shaved head.

techniques.name: Tiger Claw
techniques.real_description: A tearing strike with the fingers curved like a tiger's talons.

styles.name: Pankration
styles.stance: Upright, hands extended, ready for both boxing and wrestling.
styles.philosophy_in_one_line: All powers: the original mixed martial art of the Olympic games.
styles.drawing_cues: Naked or minimal clothing, athletic build.

techniques.name: Overhand Smash
techniques.real_description: A heavy, downward-looping punch from the rear hand.

styles.name: Escrima
styles.stance: Mobile, lead hand forward, often holding a stick or blade.
styles.philosophy_in_one_line: Flowing weapon strikes and empty-hand translations.
styles.drawing_cues: Holding a short stick, rapid hand movements.

techniques.name: Sinawali
techniques.real_description: A rapid, weaving double-strike pattern.

styles.name: Hapkido
styles.stance: Similar to Taekwondo but more grounded and ready to grab.
styles.philosophy_in_one_line: Circular motion and joint locks combined with powerful kicking.
styles.drawing_cues: Dobok, high kicks, wrist-grabbing poses.

techniques.name: Joint Lock Throw
techniques.real_description: Grabbing the wrist and twisting to force the opponent down.

styles.name: Bokator
styles.stance: Animal-based, very low and grounded, hands often mimicking claws.
styles.philosophy_in_one_line: Ancient battlefield combat using every part of the body.
styles.drawing_cues: Krama scarf around waist/head, tattoos.

techniques.name: Crocodile Tail Kick
techniques.real_description: A low, spinning sweep that takes out the opponent's legs.

styles.name: Kalaripayattu
styles.stance: Extremely low, wide stances (Lion, Elephant), high jumps.
styles.philosophy_in_one_line: The mother of all martial arts: fluid, athletic, and lethal.
styles.drawing_cues: Bare chest, dhoti cloth, high-flying leaps.

techniques.name: Jumping Strike
techniques.real_description: A high, flying leap ending in a downward strike.

styles.name: MMA
styles.stance: Hybrid: mid-height, mobile, hands ready for strikes or takedown defense.
styles.philosophy_in_one_line: The integration of all effective combat disciplines.
styles.drawing_cues: 4oz gloves, board shorts, versatile posture.

techniques.name: Superman Punch
techniques.real_description: Faking a kick to launch into a flying long-range punch.

styles.name: Kickboxing
styles.stance: High guard, square shoulders, ready to check kicks.
styles.philosophy_in_one_line: High-volume combinations of boxing and heavy low kicks.
styles.drawing_cues: Boxing gloves, kickboxing shorts, rhythmic bouncing.

techniques.name: Low Kick
techniques.real_description: A heavy roundhouse kick to the opponent's thigh.
